Team —

We need a concise, cross-functional plan to retire the legacy text-gen v1 endpoint used by several customers (notably Acme). Key asks:

- Propose a staggered schedule (canaries -> phased cutover -> final shutdown).
- Customer comms cadence and templated notices (30/14/7/1 days).
- Exceptions/escape-hatch process for high-volume endpoints. Who approves?
- Technical compatibility mitigations (shims, routing fallback) and rollback steps.

Please reply with suggested timelines, owners, and any blockers by EOD Wed. I attached a starter matrix (sunset-matrix.xlsx).

Thanks,

Marissa —

Quick pass from GTM / customer ops perspective:

- Proposed schedule (high level):
  * Week 0 (canary invites): small set of customers (5–10) for functional canaries.
  * Week 2 (wider phased cutover): invite 30% of customers to switch; monitor error rates + cost delta.
  * Week 6 (final cutover window): all remaining customers receive forced migration with opt-out exceptions reviewed case-by-case.

- Customer notice cadence: initial notice (30d) -> migration guide + opt-in canary invite (14d) -> reminder (7d) -> final notice (1d). Templates in customer-comm-templates.docx.

- Exceptions: propose an Exceptions Committee (GTM + Product + Legal) to approve SLA or contract carve-outs; approval target = 48 hrs for production-impacting exceptions.

Blockers: we need a clear testing checklist for canaries (latency, cost, quality regressions) and a single point of contact for each customer. I can own customer comms and the tracking spreadsheet.

Ben
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

Folks —

Technical notes / requirements from Serving / Runtime team:

- Compatibility: we should offer a routing shim for 6 weeks post-cutover that rewrites requests to the new model when safe (low-latency add-on). This will mitigate simple param differences.
- KV cache: v1 customers using long-context sessions will need a KV migration strategy; plan to disable long-lived KV reuse across model versions by default.
- Quantization/quality delta: run a small evaluation set during canaries to measure hallucination and prompt sensitivity; if delta > 3% we hold the customer for manual review.
- Rollback: full rollback should be automated per-customer via a routing flag and completed within 2 hours for approved exceptions.

I'll produce a short runbook (canary-runbook.md) with test harnesses, alert thresholds, and rollback commands. Need product to prioritize two API compatibility shims tickets (SERV-1123, SERV-1124).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving
